supplementary_clean_state_rebuild.question: Does the fixed source state build from a clean materialization, and does that build run the core path?

materialization.method: git archive HEAD | tar -x  +  git apply RC_TRACKED_DIFF.patch  +  copy the 23 untracked files named in the freeze
materialization.note: git archive carries tracked HEAD content only; the patch carries tracked modifications; untracked files are copied, so this is a reconstruction of the frozen state, not a checkout of a committed release

build.command: xcodebuild build-for-testing ... -derivedDataPath cleanroom/derived (same flags as step 2)

build_path_strings_embedded.method: strings -a | grep -c on the two dylibs
build_path_strings_embedded.interpretation: each dylib carries its own absolute build path, and LC_UUID differs per link, so Debug products are path- and link-stamped rather than bit-reproducible
